# Exterior surface maps

The tiled scan sources below are [Poly Haven CC0 1.0 assets](https://polyhaven.com/license). Each wall or ground finish uses a 512 px resample of the 1K source normal and packed AO, roughness and metallic maps. The diffuse images retain source luminance detail and are graded around neutral material swatches. The copper retains the authored procedural finish.

| Finish | Scan |
| --- | --- |
| Ivory | [White Plaster 02](https://polyhaven.com/a/white_plaster_02) |
| Terracotta | [Clay Plaster](https://polyhaven.com/a/clay_plaster) |
| Brown masonry | [Concrete Wall 003](https://polyhaven.com/a/concrete_wall_003) |
| Grass | [Leafy Grass](https://polyhaven.com/a/leafy_grass) |
| Wood | [Brown Planks 05](https://polyhaven.com/a/brown_planks_05) |
| Paving | [Grey Stone Path](https://polyhaven.com/a/grey_stone_path) |

The source preparation script takes the 1K downloads named `<asset>-diff`, `<asset>-nor_gl` and `<asset>-arm` with their original image encoding. The podium's separate baked ambient-occlusion atlas belongs to the geometry and is embedded in the Blender and browser assets.
